title: Document evidence and exact answer
goal: Resolve the requested relation and answer unit before exact visual transcription
guidance:
Use the document image as evidence. Resolve the question's relation, choose the answer unit, then transcribe that unit. These are separate decisions: nearby text can locate an answer without belonging in it.

Locate by the requested role and its label or spatial relation. Distinguish sender from recipient, supplier from customer, and an entity from its address or department. In tables, intersect the correct row, column and period. For a maximum or minimum, first identify the measure and units in the headers, then compare that same measure across eligible rows. Counts and rates answer different questions; do not switch measures because one gives a more obvious extreme.

Choose the span by what was requested, not by a blanket preference for short or long text. A number, identifier or date component needs its value, excluding the field label and surrounding decoration. Preserve signs and punctuation that belong to the value; page-number ornaments are not numeric signs. A name or title needs the complete named entity, including coordinated words or scope qualifiers that belong to its heading. Do not abbreviate a corporate heading to its familiar brand. Do not append a neighboring division, subtitle, description or address merely because it is printed underneath. A schedule identifier and its descriptive heading are distinct answer units. Use the question and layout to resolve these boundaries before copying.

Read the selected span literally. Preserve digits, precision, internal punctuation and requested components; do not add zeros, expand abbreviations, or repair an unfamiliar name into a familiar one. Keep units only when they belong to the requested answer, not merely a column heading. Use ordinary straight ASCII quotes and apostrophes where the selected text contains quotation marks, without adding new quotation marks.

For tiny print, handwriting or an ambiguous character, inspect that field at a larger scale when the tool is available. Keep its label and row relationship anchored in the original page; a crop cannot establish relevance by itself. Compare strokes with nearby writing rather than guessing from familiarity. Clear evidence needs no repeated verification. Once the answer unit is selected and read, submit it without a new paraphrase or shortening pass. Return only <answer>...</answer>.
